name: plasma-setup

user:
cmake -B build -D CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=$KF6_PREFIX \
      -D CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBEXECDIR=libexec \
      -D CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release \
      -D BUILD_QT5=OFF \
      -D BUILD_TESTING=OFF \
      -W no-dev .

post_install: id -u plasma-setup >/dev/null 2>&1 || useradd -r -g plasma-setup -d /run/plasma-setup -s /bin/bash -c "Plasma Setup" plasma-setup
command -v systemd-tmpfiles >/dev/null && systemd-tmpfiles --create || install -d -o plasma-setup -g plasma-setup -m 750 /run/plasma-setup
